actionConfiguration.body:
select *
from public.save_contact_master(
  null::bigint,

  {{ appsmith.store.current_client_id }}::uuid,

  {{ (inpVenueContactName.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,
  {{ (inpVenueContactTitle.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,
  {{ (inpVenueContactPhone.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,
  {{ (inpVenueContactMobile.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,
  {{ (inpVenueContactEmail.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,
  {{ (inpVenueContactNotes.text ?? "").trim() }}::text,

  true::boolean,

  '{}'::bigint[],

  case
    when coalesce(
      {{ Number(appsmith.store.current_venue_id || 0) }},
      0
    ) > 0
    then array[
      {{ Number(appsmith.store.current_venue_id || 0) }}
    ]::bigint[]
    else '{}'::bigint[]
  end
);
